final_message:
All 6 tests pass. Both bugs were in `lrucache/cache.py`:

- `get` (line 30) returned early without `move_to_end`, so reads didn't refresh recency and a just-read key was still evicted first.
- `put` (line 33) evicted whenever the cache was full, even when the key already existed — an in-place update needlessly dropped the oldest entry.

Root causes written up in `SOLUTION.md`.
